sections.title: Describe an upcoming plan
sections.content: Combine future plans, personal obligations, time expressions and familiar present-tense language to talk about an upcoming trip or weekend.

sections.title: Planning a trip
rows: La próxima semana voy a viajar.
Next week I am going to travel.
El viernes voy a preparar la maleta.
On Friday I am going to prepare my suitcase.
El domingo voy a volver a casa.
On Sunday I am going to return home.

items.spanish: La próxima semana voy a viajar.
items.english: Next week I am going to travel.

items.spanish: El sábado vamos a tomar el tren.
items.english: On Saturday we are going to take the train.

sections.content: Organise a future plan with time expressions: *la próxima semana*, *el viernes*, *el sábado*, *el domingo*.
